newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Qingling posts higher 9-mth net profit.
newsitem.headline: Qingling posts higher 9-mth net profit.

text.p: China car-maker Qingling Motors Co Ltd said on Monday it posted an unaudited net profit of 309.23 million yuan for the first nine months of 1996, up from 89.90 million the previous year.
Earnings per share rose to 0.15 yuan in the nine month period from 0.04 yuan and turnover was 2.80 billion yuan in the period against 2.25 billion a year earlier, the company said in a statement.
Qingling also said a preliminary offering circular of a proposed issue of convertible bonds is being prepared for distribution to professional and institutional investors.
A copy of the circular will be despatched to shareholders for information as soon as practicable, Qingling said.
The company said late last year that it was studying the possibility of issuing US$100 million in bonds that could be convertible into H-shares of the company.
